objects: A counter sees only __mul__ and passes schoolbookM/A while missing DIV/POW/S/I routes.
Arbitrary rows are offered as decomposition certificates without legal point sums.
A precise0.01 paired delta is assigned both primary agreement and disagreement.
A profiled timing component is substituted for the unprofiled primary clock.
